correctness.rationale: Exact finite Blaschke product with conjugate roots of modulus 1/sqrt(8) is an analytic disk self-map. Odd/even integrations yield a global normalized member with precisely the required symmetric-point subordination. Exact rational series and direct determinant algebra give -10700387/169869312, greater in modulus than 1/16 by 83555/169869312 and greater than 769/12288 by 69731/169869312. Standalone exact-arithmetic program verifies the finite calculations and power-series identity; infinite analytic membership is proved separately.

originality.rationale: The same class and same Hankel functional are explicitly stated in the 2025 conjecture and 2026 theorem. The new exact rational Blaschke witness contradicts the two cited upper statements and is not a logical corollary of either. Searches of published mathematical records and literature for the domain, constants, defining subordination, and aliases yielded no equivalent witness or stronger covering counterexample. This is best-knowledge originality, not a mathematical guarantee of uniqueness.

value.rationale: Disproves a natural sharp conjecture from 2025 and a numerically close universal upper theorem from 2026 for the exact same starlike symmetric-point class. The witness gives a strict certified lower bound for the unknown sharp supremum, a substantive boundary of what is mathematically possible, not a minor routine improvement. Does not claim exact extremality.
